rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name + zip and operated only on the user’s own orders. It looked up the relevant orders and product variants and made accurate changes and price adjustments consistent with tool outputs. However, it performed two order-changing writes without prior explicit user confirmation: (1) updating the shipping address on the pending watch order and (2) changing the silicone watch to a metal (white) variant. The agent did obtain confirmation before modifying the pending air purifier, which was correct. Due to the missing confirmations on earlier writes, the interaction fails the policy pass bar despite otherwise correct actions and information.
